import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Resultant.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Prod
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

/-! Actual bounded polynomials, endowed with their coefficient norm.
No polynomial, derivative or determinant identity is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev Coeff (n : ℕ) := Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n

instance coeffNormedAddCommGroup (n : ℕ) : NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff n) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)
    (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective

instance coeffNormedSpace (n : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff n) :=
  NormedSpace.induced ℝ _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)

/-- Retain exactly the coefficients of orders less than `n`. -/
def cut (n : ℕ) : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ i)

@[simp] theorem degreeLTEquiv_coeff {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) (i : Fin n) :
    degreeLTEquiv ℝ n p i = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

@[simp] theorem cut_coeff (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (i : Fin n) :
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = p.coeff i := by
  exact congrFun ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).apply_symm_apply (fun j : Fin n => p.coeff j)) i

@[simp] theorem cut_coe {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : cut n (p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  simp

/-- Coefficient truncation of the actual polynomial product, as a bilinear map. -/
def mulLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun p q => cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])))
    (by intros; simp [add_mul])
    (by intros; simp [smul_mul_assoc])
    (by intros; simp [mul_add])
    (by intros; simp [mul_smul_comm])

def mulCLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →L[ℝ] Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap :
      (Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r)).toLinearMap.comp
      (mulLM m n r))

@[simp] theorem mulCLM_apply {m n r : ℕ} (p : Coeff m) (q : Coeff n) :
    mulCLM m n r p q = cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])) := rfl

/-- The linear inclusion of a polynomial of degree `< n` into degree `< n+1`. -/
def liftLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+1)).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype

def liftCLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (liftLM n)

lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_bound {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) {k : ℕ} (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).coeff k = 0 := by
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    ((Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))

@[simp] theorem coe_lift {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (liftCLM n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  by_cases hk : k < n+1
  · exact cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,hk⟩
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

def topMonomial (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  ⟨X^n, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)⟩

def monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  topMonomial n + liftCLM n p

@[simp] theorem coe_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]) = X^n + (p : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [monicPoly, topMonomial]

lemma bounded_natDegree {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)

/-- The affine monic-coordinate map has the actual Frechet derivative equal
    to its coefficient inclusion, including the degree-zero case. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicPoly (liftCLM n) p := by
  exact (liftCLM n).hasFDerivAt.const_add (topMonomial n)

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree
open Module

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- The derivative block occurring in polynomial numerator/denominator gluing. -/
def repeatedBlock (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E) +
      L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E))

@[simp] theorem repeatedBlock_apply (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    repeatedBlock L C x = (L x.1, C x.1 + L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF) (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, repeatedBlock]

/-- An exact determinant theorem: no nonsingularity assumptions on either block. -/
theorem det_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [toMatrix_repeatedBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, pow_two]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual triangular linear maps, with fully specified coefficient bases. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def lowerBlock (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (E × F) →L[ℝ] (E × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F) + M.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F))

@[simp] lemma lowerBlock_apply (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F)
    (M : F →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × F) :
    lowerBlock L C M x = (L x.1, C x.1 + M x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap) (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, lowerBlock]

theorem det_lowerBlock {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bF) (bE.prod bF) (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bE L.toLinearMap).det *
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bF bF M.toLinearMap).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_lowerBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Triangular
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Determinant

/-! Basis-independent determinant calculus for the actual finite-dimensional
Fréchet derivative. Used after explicit coefficient permutation equivalences. -/
open Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- Determinant of the actual derivative of an endomorphism. -/
def endJacobian (f : E → E) (x : E) : ℝ := LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap

lemma endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt {f : E → E} {L : E →L[ℝ] E} {x : E}
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f L x) : endJacobian f x = LinearMap.det L.toLinearMap := by
  rw [endJacobian, hf.fderiv]

theorem endJacobian_comp {f g : E → E} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g x)) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    endJacobian (f ∘ g) x = endJacobian f (g x) * endJacobian g x := by
  rw [endJacobian, (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x hg.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
  exact LinearMap.det_comp _ _

/-- Conjugation transports coordinates without changing the derivative determinant. -/
theorem endJacobian_conjugate (e : E ≃L[ℝ] F) (f : E → E) (x : F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (e.symm x)) :
    endJacobian (fun z => e (f (e.symm z))) x = endJacobian f (e.symm x) := by
  have h := e.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt)
  have he : fderiv ℝ (fun z => e (f (e.symm z))) x =
      e.toContinuousLinearMap.comp ((fderiv ℝ f (e.symm x)).comp e.symm.toContinuousLinearMap) := h.fderiv
  rw [endJacobian, he]
  change LinearMap.det (e.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.comp
    ((fderiv ℝ f (e.symm x)).toLinearMap.comp e.symm.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap)) = _
  exact LinearMap.det_conj _ e.toLinearEquiv

/-- Triangular block determinant, independent of the choice of bases. -/
lemma endDet_lowerBlock [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (C : E →L[ℝ] F) (M : F →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.det (lowerBlock L C M).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.det L.toLinearMap * LinearMap.det M.toLinearMap := by
  simpa only [LinearMap.det_toMatrix] using
    det_lowerBlock (Module.finBasis ℝ E) (Module.finBasis ℝ F) L C M

/-- A map on the first factor and identity on the second factor. -/
def keepFunction (f : E → E) (z : E × F) : E × F := (f z.1,z.2)

lemma hasFDerivAt_keepFunction {f : E → E} (x : E × F)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.1) :
    HasFDerivAt (keepFunction (F := F) f)
      ((fderiv ℝ f x.1).prodMap (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)) x := by
  exact (hf.hasFDerivAt.comp x (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt).prodMk
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E F).hasFDerivAt

lemma endJacobian_keepFunction [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    (f : E → E) (x : E × F) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.1) :
    endJacobian (keepFunction (F := F) f) x = endJacobian f x.1 := by
  rw [endJacobian_of_hasFDerivAt (hasFDerivAt_keepFunction x hf)]
  change LinearMap.det (LinearMap.prodMap (fderiv ℝ f x.1).toLinearMap (LinearMap.id : F →ₗ[ℝ] F)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.det_prodMap, LinearMap.det_id, mul_one]
  rfl

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

/-! Leading-coefficient charts for the actual bounded polynomial spaces. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).Monic := by
  rw [coe_monicPoly]
  exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property)

@[simp] lemma monicPoly_coeff_top {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).coeff n = 1 := by
  simp [coe_monicPoly, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p le_rfl]

@[simp] lemma natDegree_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).natDegree = n := by
  apply le_antisymm (bounded_natDegree _)
  exact Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (by
    rw [monicPoly_coeff_top]
    exact one_ne_zero)

lemma cut_X_pow_of_le (n k : ℕ) (hnk : n ≤ k) : cut n (X^k) = 0 := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (X^k) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = 0
  rw [cut_coeff]
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, show (i : ℕ) ≠ k from by omega]

/-- Assemble a leading coefficient and all lower coefficients, without division. -/
def joinLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) where
  toFun x := x.1 • topMonomial n + liftCLM n x.2
  map_add' x y := by simp [add_smul]; abel
  map_smul' c x := by simp [smul_add, smul_smul]

@[simp] lemma coe_joinLeadingLM {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (joinLeadingLM n x : ℝ[X]) = x.1 • (X^n : ℝ[X]) + (x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [joinLeadingLM, topMonomial]

/-- Split a bounded polynomial into its leading coefficient and its truncation. -/
def splitLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →ₗ[ℝ] (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  ((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype).prod
    ((cut n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

@[simp] lemma splitLeadingLM_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    splitLeadingLM n p = ((p : ℝ[X]).coeff n, cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := rfl

lemma split_joinLeading {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    splitLeadingLM n (joinLeadingLM n x) = x := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2 le_rfl]
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl]

lemma join_splitLeading {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    joinLeadingLM n (splitLeadingLM n p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_joinLeadingLM]
  ext k
  simp only [splitLeadingLM_apply, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with h | h | h
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt h), mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,h⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, mul_one, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt h), mul_zero,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ h.le, zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

/-- The exact linear isomorphism between high-first and ordinary polynomial coefficients. -/
def leadingEquiv (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  { joinLeadingLM n with
    invFun := splitLeadingLM n
    left_inv := split_joinLeading
    right_inv := join_splitLeading }

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    leadingEquiv n x = joinLeadingLM n x := rfl

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (leadingEquiv n).symm p = splitLeadingLM n p := rfl

lemma monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    monicPoly p = leadingEquiv n (1,p) := by
  simp [monicPoly, leadingEquiv, joinLeadingLM]

/-- Leading degree first, then increasing lower degrees. -/
def leadingBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (Unit ⊕ Fin n) ℝ (Coeff (n+1)) :=
  ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).map (leadingEquiv n)

/-- Truncation is exact whenever the original polynomial already satisfies the bound. -/
lemma coe_cut_of_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n) :
    (cut n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  let q : Coeff n := ⟨p, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩
  exact congrArg (fun z : Coeff n => (z : ℝ[X])) (cut_coe q)

/-- Actual monic polynomials are recovered from their non-leading coefficients. -/
lemma monic_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = n) :
    (monicPoly (cut n p) : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  rw [coe_monicPoly, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with hk | hk | hk
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt hk), zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n p ⟨k,hk⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
    rw [← hd, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, hp]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hk), zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ hk.le,
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]

end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! The monic-numerator scaling factor, including zero scale and degree zero. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Generic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) : ℝ × E := (x.1, x.1 • x.2)

def scaleChartDerivative (x : ℝ × E) : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).prod
    (x.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E +
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight x.2)

/-- The actual derivative of multiplication of the lower coefficients by the scale. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_scaleChart (x : ℝ × E) :
    HasFDerivAt scaleChart (scaleChartDerivative x) x := by
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.prodMk
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt.smul
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E).hasFDerivAt)

lemma toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap =
    Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 0
      (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Unit) => b.repr x.2 i) (x.1 • (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ)) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

/-- An all-dimensional, all-scale determinant identity, not a generic-rank statement. -/
theorem det_scaleChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (x : ℝ × E) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (scaleChartDerivative x).toLinearMap).det =
      x.1 ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [toMatrix_scaleChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp [Matrix.det_smul]

end Generic

/-- Multiplication of an actual monic polynomial by its unrestricted scalar. -/
def scaleMonic {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) := x.1 • monicPoly x.2

lemma scaleMonic_eq_comp {n : ℕ} :
    scaleMonic (n := n) = (leadingEquiv n) ∘ scaleChart := by
  funext x
  rw [scaleMonic, monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv]
  symm
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply, scaleChart, Prod.smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using
    (leadingEquiv n).map_smul x.1 (1,x.2)

def scaleMonicDerivative {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (ℝ × Coeff n) →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (scaleChartDerivative x)

theorem hasFDerivAt_scaleMonic {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt scaleMonic (scaleMonicDerivative x) x := by
  rw [scaleMonic_eq_comp]
  exact (leadingEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp
    x (hasFDerivAt_scaleChart x)

lemma toMatrix_comp_equiv {E F G : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℝ F] [AddCommGroup G] [Module ℝ G]
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (e : F ≃ₗ[ℝ] G) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix bE (bF.map e) (e.toLinearMap.comp L) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Basis.map_repr]

/-- The Jacobian in the manuscript's leading-first numerator coefficient order. -/
def monicScalingJacobian {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n))
    (leadingBasis n) (fderiv ℝ scaleMonic x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The exact factor c^n for a monic polynomial of degree n. -/

/-! The actual coefficient transformation P=(X+d)F-N at a rooted compartment. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Generic
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def rootChart (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) : E × (ℝ × E) :=
  (x.1, (x.2.1 + C x.1, D x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1 - x.2.2))

def rootFiber (f : E) : (ℝ × E) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).prod
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight f - ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E)

@[simp] lemma rootFiber_apply (f : E) (h : ℝ × E) :
    rootFiber f h = (h.1, h.1 • f - h.2) := rfl

def rootChartDerivative (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] (E × (ℝ × E)) :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)
    (C.prod (D + x.2.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) (rootFiber x.1)

/-- This is the Frechet derivative of the actual root coefficient operation. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rootChart (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    HasFDerivAt (rootChart C D) (rootChartDerivative C D x) x := by
  let F : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E (ℝ × E)
  let B : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × E))
  let N : (E × (ℝ × E)) →L[ℝ] E :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × E))
  have hb := B.hasFDerivAt.add (C.hasFDerivAt.comp x F.hasFDerivAt)
  have hn := ((D.hasFDerivAt.comp x F.hasFDerivAt).add
    (B.hasFDerivAt.smul F.hasFDerivAt)).sub N.hasFDerivAt
  apply (F.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hb.prodMk hn)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change h.2.1 + C h.1 = C h.1 + h.2.1
      abel
    · change D h.1 + (x.2.1 • h.1 + h.2.1 • x.1) - h.2.2 =
        (D h.1 + x.2.1 • h.1) + (h.2.1 • x.1 - h.2.2)
      abel

      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (rootFiber f).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 0
        (Matrix.of fun i (_ : Unit) => b.repr f i) (-1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rootFiber, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (f : E) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b)
      ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b) (rootFiber f).toLinearMap).det =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [toMatrix_rootFiber, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp [Matrix.det_neg]

/-- The root operation is a polynomial coordinate change with determinant ±1
at every coefficient vector, not just away from a discriminant or zero rates. -/
theorem det_rootChartDerivative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι ℝ E) (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E →L[ℝ] E) (x : E × (ℝ × E)) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b))
      (b.prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod b))
      (rootChartDerivative C D x).toLinearMap).det = (-1 : ℝ) ^ Fintype.card ι := by
  rw [rootChartDerivative, det_lowerBlock, det_rootFiber]
  simp

end Generic

def shiftTop (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=

/-- Lower coefficients of the actual polynomial X*f. -/
def shiftLow (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    (((cut n).comp (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (X : ℝ[X]))).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype)

/-- Physical Schur-complement root polynomial, before any response cancellation. -/
def rootPolynomial {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) : ℝ[X] :=
  (X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) - (x.2.2 : ℝ[X])

lemma rootPolynomial_cut {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    cut n (rootPolynomial x) = shiftLow n x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1 - x.2.2 := by
  simp only [rootPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add, map_sub, map_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^n = X^(n+1) by rw [pow_succ'],
    cut_X_pow_of_le n (n+1) (by omega)]
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl, smul_zero]
  rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, cut_coe, cut_coe]
  change 0 + 0 + (shiftLow n x.1 + x.2.1 • x.1) - x.2.2 = _
  abel

    (rootPolynomial x).coeff n = x.2.1 + shiftTop n x.1 := by
  simp only [rootPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^n = X^(n+1) by rw [pow_succ']]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.1 le_rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2.2 le_rfl,

    sub_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [ite_true, mul_one]
  rfl

/-- The actual (unreduced) root polynomial coefficient chart. -/
def rootCoefficientMap {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  (x.1, ((rootPolynomial x).coeff n, cut n (rootPolynomial x)))

lemma rootCoefficientMap_eq {n : ℕ} :
    rootCoefficientMap (n := n) = rootChart (shiftTop n) (shiftLow n) := by
  funext x
  simp [rootCoefficientMap, rootChart, rootPolynomial_cut, rootPolynomial_coeff_next]

    HasFDerivAt rootCoefficientMap (rootChartDerivative (shiftTop n) (shiftLow n) x) x := by
  rw [rootCoefficientMap_eq]
  exact hasFDerivAt_rootChart _ _ _

def rootCoefficientJacobian {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ n).prod ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)))
    (fderiv ℝ rootCoefficientMap x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The true polynomial coefficient-map derivative has determinant (-1)^n,
without assuming invertibility, positivity, or absence of common roots. -/
theorem rootCoefficientJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    rootCoefficientJacobian x = (-1 : ℝ)^n := by
  rw [rootCoefficientJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rootCoefficientMap x).fderiv,
    det_rootChartDerivative]
  simp

lemma degree_rootProduct {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    ((X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X])).degree = ((n+1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
  rw [Polynomial.degree_mul, Polynomial.degree_X_add_C,
    Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree (monic_monicPoly x.1).ne_zero,
    natDegree_monicPoly]
  simp [Nat.cast_add, add_comm]

    (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]).degree < ((X + C x.2.1) * (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X])).degree := by
  rw [degree_rootProduct]
  exact (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp x.2.2.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ n)

theorem rootPolynomial_monic {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (rootPolynomial x).Monic := by
  exact ((Polynomial.monic_X_add_C x.2.1).mul (monic_monicPoly x.1)).sub_of_left

  apply Polynomial.natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some
  rw [rootPolynomial, Polynomial.degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt (rootNumerator_degree_lt x),

theorem rootPolynomial_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (x : Coeff n × (ℝ × Coeff n)) :
    (monicPoly (cut (n+1) (rootPolynomial x)) : ℝ[X]) = rootPolynomial x :=
  monic_reconstruct _ (rootPolynomial_monic x) (rootPolynomial_natDegree x)

open Module

namespace HydrologyTree

variable {P E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

abbrev RootTransitionSpace (P E : Type*) := P × ((ℝ × ℝ) × E)

def rootTransition (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E)
    (x : RootTransitionSpace P E) : RootTransitionSpace P E :=
  (x.1, ((x.2.1.1 + α x.1, β x.1 + x.2.1.1 * α x.1 - x.2.1.2),
    L x.1 + x.2.1.1 • K x.1 - x.2.1.2 • x.2.2))

def rootTransitionCross (α β : P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L K : P →L[ℝ] E) (d : ℝ) :
    P →L[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ) × E) := (α.prod (β + d • α)).prod (L + d • K)

def rootTransitionFiberCross (K : P →L[ℝ] E) (p : P) (q : E) : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] E :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight (K p) -
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).smulRight q

    (x : RootTransitionSpace P E) : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] RootTransitionSpace P E :=
  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ P) (rootTransitionCross α β L K x.2.1.1)
    (lowerBlock (rootFiber (α x.1)) (rootTransitionFiberCross K x.1 x.2.2)
      (-x.2.1.2 • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))

  let A : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] P := ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ P _
  let B : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ) × E) := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ P _
  let D : RootTransitionSpace P E →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) E).comp B)

    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) E).comp B)

open Polynomial Module

namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PathCoefficients (n : ℕ) := Coeff (n+1) × Coeff n
abbrev PathPolyData (n : ℕ) := RootTransitionSpace (Coeff (n+1)) (Coeff n)

lemma cut_cut {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (p : ℝ[X]) :
    cut n (cut m p : ℝ[X]) = cut n p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (cut m p : ℝ[X]) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i =
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i
  rw [cut_coeff, cut_coeff]
  exact cut_coeff m p ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h⟩

/-- High-first two coefficients and the remaining low coefficients. -/
def topTwoEquiv (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+2) ≃ₗ[ℝ] ((ℝ × ℝ) × Coeff n) :=
  (leadingEquiv (n+1)).symm |>.trans
    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ ℝ).prodCongr (leadingEquiv n).symm) |>.trans
    (LinearEquiv.prodAssoc ℝ ℝ ℝ (Coeff n)).symm

    topTwoEquiv n p =
      (((p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1), (p : ℝ[X]).coeff n), cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := by
  change (((p : ℝ[X]).coeff (n+1), ((cut (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X])).coeff n),
      cut n (cut (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) : ℝ[X])) = _

    ((LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (Coeff (n+1))).prodCongr (topTwoEquiv n))

  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.1 le_rfl,
    coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.2.2 (Nat.le_succ n),
    if_neg (show n+1 ≠ n+2 from by omega), if_neg (show n+1 ≠ n from by omega),

  rfl

  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]
  simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound z.2.2 le_rfl,
    if_neg (show n ≠ n+2 from by omega), if_neg (show n ≠ n+1 from by omega),

    cut n (pathStepPolynomial z) =
      pathShift n z.1 + z.2.1.1 • pathLow n z.1 - z.2.1.2 • z.2.2 := by
  simp only [pathStepPolynomial, coe_monicPoly, add_mul, mul_add, map_sub, map_add]
  rw [show (X : ℝ[X]) * X^(n+1) = X^(n+2) by exact (pow_succ' (X : ℝ[X]) (n+1)).symm]

theorem parentCoefficient_step_eq {n : ℕ} (z : PathPolyData n) :

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.SchurComplement
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Block

/-! Actual conservative tree rate coordinates, with arbitrary finite size.
Vertices are topologically numbered from the designated leak/root 0.
The parameter at 0 is the leak; at every other vertex it is the transfer rate
toward its parent. No positivity or nonzero-rate premise is used below. -/
open Module Matrix
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- A finite rooted tree in a topological vertex numbering. Every nonroot
vertex i+1 has exactly one parent, with smaller vertex number. -/
structure OrderedTree (n : ℕ) where
  parent : Fin n → Fin (n+1)
  parent_le : ∀ i, (parent i).val ≤ i.val

abbrev VertexValues (n : ℕ) := Fin (n+1) → ℝ
abbrev EdgeValues (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ
abbrev TreeRates (n : ℕ) := VertexValues n × EdgeValues n

lemma parent_ne_child {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (i : Fin n) :
    t.parent i ≠ i.succ := by
  intro h
  have hle := t.parent_le i
  have := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_succ] at this
  omega

/-- Parent-incidence matrix of the actual labelled tree. -/
def parentIncidence {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin n) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun v e => if t.parent e = v then 1 else 0

/-- Derivative of c_e=a_e f_e with respect to the inward/diagonal parameters. -/
def childWeighted {n : ℕ} (f : EdgeValues n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ :=
  Matrix.of fun e v => if e.succ = v then f e else 0

def parentCLM {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) : EdgeValues n →L[ℝ] VertexValues n :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' (parentIncidence t))

@[simp] lemma parentCLM_apply {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (v : Fin (n+1)) :
    parentCLM t f v = ∑ e, if t.parent e = v then f e else 0 := by
  simp [parentCLM, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    parentIncidence, ite_mul]

/-- Physical rate chart: d_v is the sum of all rates leaving v, and c_e is
exactly the product of the two opposed rates on edge e. -/
def rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : TreeRates n :=
  (x.1 + parentCLM t x.2, fun e => x.1 e.succ * x.2 e)

def rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    TreeRates n →L[ℝ] TreeRates n :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)) +
    (parentCLM t).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).prod
    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun e : Fin n =>
      x.1 e.succ • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))) +
      x.2 e • ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))))

/-- The rate-coordinate Jacobian is derived from the actual polynomial map. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_rateChart {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    HasFDerivAt (rateChart t) (rateChartDerivative t x) x := by
  apply HasFDerivAt.prodMk
  · exact (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt.add
      ((parentCLM t).hasFDerivAt.comp x
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n)).hasFDerivAt)
  · apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro e
    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e.succ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt.mul
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj e).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).hasFDerivAt

lemma toMatrix_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks 1 (parentIncidence t) (childWeighted x.2)
        (Matrix.diagonal fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, rateChartDerivative, childWeighted,
      parentIncidence, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply,
      Pi.basisFun_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rename_i v j
  symm
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro e _ he
    simp [Ne.symm he]
  · simp

lemma childWeighted_mul_parent {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (f : EdgeValues n)
    (i j : Fin n) :
    (childWeighted f * parentIncidence t) i j = if t.parent j = i.succ then f i else 0 := by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, childWeighted, parentIncidence, ite_mul, eq_comm]

lemma rateSchur_upperTriangular {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t).IsUpperTriangular := by
  intro i j hij
  have hne : t.parent j ≠ i.succ := by
    intro h
    have hle := t.parent_le j
    have hh := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ] at hh
    have hijv : j.val < i.val := hij
    omega
  have hneq : i ≠ j := ne_of_gt (show j < i from hij)
  simp [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, childWeighted_mul_parent,
    hne, hneq]

lemma rateSchur_diagonal {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) (i : Fin n) :
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun e : Fin n => x.1 e.succ) -
      childWeighted x.2 * parentIncidence t) i i = x.1 i.succ := by
  simp [childWeighted_mul_parent, parent_ne_child]

/-- The exact physical-rate Jacobian, for every tree size and all real rates.
In particular, zero edges are not excluded by an inverse-rate calculation. -/
theorem det_rateChartDerivative {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
      (rateChartDerivative t x).toLinearMap).det = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [toMatrix_rateChartDerivative, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_one₁₁,
    Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular (rateSchur_upperTriangular t x)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact rateSchur_diagonal t x i

/-- The true Frechet Jacobian, not a separately prescribed formal matrix. -/
def physicalRateJacobian {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    ((Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin (n+1))).prod (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fderiv ℝ (rateChart t) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem physicalRateJacobian_eq {n : ℕ} (t : OrderedTree n) (x : TreeRates n) :
    physicalRateJacobian t x = ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ := by
  rw [physicalRateJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_rateChart t x).fderiv,
    det_rateChartDerivative]

end HydrologyTree

/-! Nested endpoint-path rate coordinates and their explicit permutation to
all physical inward, outward and leak coordinates. No parameter is discarded. -/
open Module Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def PathRates : ℕ → Type
  | 0 => ℝ
  | n+1 => PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)

instance pathRatesNormed : (n : ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesNormed n
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

instance pathRatesSpace : (n : ℕ) → NormedSpace ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesSpace n
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

instance pathRatesFinite : (n : ℕ) → FiniteDimensional ℝ (PathRates n)
  | 0 => inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional ℝ ℝ)
  | n+1 => by
    letI := pathRatesFinite n
    exact inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional ℝ (PathRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)))

/-- Add one new root with leak λ and outgoing rate f to the previous child rates. -/
def prependRateEquiv (n : ℕ) : (TreeRates n × (ℝ × ℝ)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates (n+1) where
  toFun z := (Fin.cons z.2.1 z.1.1, Fin.cons z.2.2 z.1.2)
  invFun x := ((Fin.tail x.1, Fin.tail x.2),(x.1 0,x.2 0))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
  map_add' z w := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
  map_smul' a z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl
    · funext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> rfl

def singletonRateEquiv : ℝ ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates 0 where
  toFun a := (fun _ => a, Fin.elim0)
  invFun x := x.1 0
  left_inv a := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i; have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _; subst i; rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  map_add' a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i
  map_smul' a b := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i

def pathRateEquiv : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n ≃ₗ[ℝ] TreeRates n
  | 0 => singletonRateEquiv
  | n+1 => ((pathRateEquiv n).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).trans (prependRateEquiv n)

@[simp] lemma pathRateEquiv_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    pathRateEquiv (n+1) z = prependRateEquiv n (pathRateEquiv n z.1,z.2) := rfl

/-- The actual root leak as a continuous linear function of all path rates. -/
def pathLeak (n : ℕ) : PathRates n →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (((LinearMap.proj 0).comp
    (LinearMap.fst ℝ (VertexValues n) (EdgeValues n))).comp (pathRateEquiv n).toLinearMap)

@[simp] lemma pathLeak_apply (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates n) :
    pathLeak n z = (pathRateEquiv n z).1 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma pathLeak_succ (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) : pathLeak (n+1) z = z.2.1 := rfl

/-- The exact monomial, including all zero-rate boundaries. -/
def pathWeight : (n : ℕ) → PathRates n → ℝ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | n+1, z => (pathLeak n z.1)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n * pathWeight n z.1

def pathRateMonomial (n : ℕ) (x : TreeRates n) : ℝ :=
  ∏ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ ^ (n-i.val) * x.2 i ^ (n-i.val-1)

lemma pathRateMonomial_prepend (n : ℕ) (y : TreeRates n) (λ f : ℝ) :

  rw [pathRateMonomial, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [prependRateEquiv, LinearEquiv.coe_mk, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,

    pathWeight n z = pathRateMonomial n (pathRateEquiv n z) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pathWeight, pathRateMonomial]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pathWeight, pathRateEquiv_succ, pathRateMonomial_prepend, ih, pathLeak_apply]

/-- The sign depends only on size and the explicit coefficient ordering. -/
def pathOrientation : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 1
  | n+1 => (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * pathOrientation n

lemma pathOrientation_sq (n : ℕ) : pathOrientation n ^ 2 = 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => norm_num [pathOrientation]
  | succ n ih => rw [pathOrientation, mul_pow, ih, mul_one]; simp

/-! Explicit coordinate permutations for the endpoint-path coefficient map.
The normalization reads existing coefficients; it does not divide, rescale,
fit, or impose the desired Jacobian as an assumption. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- Rearrange p,(d,c),q into (p,q),(d,c). -/
def pathShuffle (n : ℕ) : PathPolyData n ≃ₗ[ℝ] (PathCoefficients n × (ℝ × ℝ)) where
  toFun z := ((z.1,z.2.2),z.2.1)
  invFun z := (z.1.1,(z.2,z.1.2))
  left_inv z := rfl
  right_inv z := rfl
  map_add' z w := rfl
  map_smul' a z := rfl

/-- A degree-one monic polynomial has just one non-leading coefficient. -/
def baseCoefficientEquiv : PathCoefficients 0 ≃ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun z := (z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0
  invFun a := (cut 1 (C a),0)
  left_inv z := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ 1).injective
      funext i
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      change ((cut 1 (C ((z.1 : ℝ[X]).coeff 0)) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = _
      rw [cut_coeff 1 _ (0 : Fin 1)]
      simp
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  right_inv a := by
    change ((cut 1 (C a) : Coeff 1) : ℝ[X]).coeff 0 = a
    rw [cut_coeff 1 (C a) (0 : Fin 1)]
    simp
  map_add' z w := by simp
  map_smul' a z := by simp

/-- The order of all original coefficient coordinates, recursively permuted. -/
def pathCoefficientEquiv : (n : ℕ) → PathCoefficients n ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathRates n
  | 0 => baseCoefficientEquiv
  | n+1 => (parentCoefficientEquiv n).trans (pathShuffle n) |>.trans
      ((pathCoefficientEquiv n).prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))

/-- From normalized child coefficients and (d,c) to the local polynomial data. -/
def pathTransitionEquiv (n : ℕ) : PathRates (n+1) ≃ₗ[ℝ] PathPolyData n :=
  (((pathCoefficientEquiv n).symm.prodCongr (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)))).trans
    (pathShuffle n).symm

lemma pathCoefficientEquiv_succ (n : ℕ) (p : PathCoefficients (n+1)) :
    pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) p = (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm (parentCoefficientEquiv n p) := rfl

/-- The actual one-child coefficient operation in the explicit common order. -/
def normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) : PathRates (n+1) :=
  pathCoefficientEquiv (n+1) (pathStepCoefficients (pathTransitionEquiv n z))

lemma normalizedPathStep_conjugate (n : ℕ) : normalizedPathStep n =
    fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z)) := by
  funext z
  rw [normalizedPathStep, pathCoefficientEquiv_succ, parentCoefficient_step_eq]

/-- Smoothness follows from the actual polynomial root operation. -/
theorem differentiable_normalizedPathStep (n : ℕ) : Differentiable ℝ (normalizedPathStep n) := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  intro z
  exact (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt.comp z
    ((hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt.comp z
        (pathTransitionEquiv n).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.differentiableAt)

theorem normalizedPathStep_jacobian (n : ℕ) (z : PathRates (n+1)) :
    endJacobian (normalizedPathStep n) z = (-1 : ℝ)^(n+1) * z.2.2^n := by
  rw [normalizedPathStep_conjugate]
  have h := endJacobian_conjugate (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv
    (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)) z
    (hasFDerivAt_rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n)
      (pathTransitionEquiv n z)).differentiableAt
  change endJacobian (fun z => (pathTransitionEquiv n).symm
      (rootTransition (pathTop n) (pathNext n) (pathShift n) (pathLow n) (pathTransitionEquiv n z))) z = _ at h
  rw [h, endJacobian_rootTransition, finrank_coeff]
  rfl

      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ) 1 0 (a • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℝ)) := by
    ext i j
    cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, scalarCouplingFiber]
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, he, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]

  lowerBlock (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) ((0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).prod (z.2.2 • a))

  let L := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  let F := (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E (ℝ × ℝ))
  have hl := L.hasFDerivAt.add F.hasFDerivAt

  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h

  · apply Prod.ext
